name: Classical Mahjong Core
description: A fixed four-seat, 136-tile Mahjong core with private hands, public discards and melds, deterministic claim priority, three winning shapes, and a compact transparent scoring profile.

rules.tiles: Exactly four stable seats use 136 tiles: three numbered suits from one through nine, four winds, and three dragons, with four physical copies of every face and no flowers.
rules.turn: Dealer starts with fourteen tiles and discards. Other turns draw one tile, may declare a concealed kong or self-draw win, and discard one tile.
rules.claims: After a discard, all three opponents respond. Win has highest priority, then kong or pung by nearest seat, then chow by the next seat only. A claimed discard moves atomically into the claimant's public meld.
rules.winning: Supported shapes are four melds and a pair, seven pairs, and thirteen orphans. Kongs count as one meld and draw a replacement tile.
rules.scoring: The Aigenora classical-core profile publishes a deliberately small additive pattern list. It is not the 81-pattern Mahjong Competition Rules profile.
rules.privacy: Only the current Leader stores the full wall and hands. Member views reveal the viewer's hand plus public rivers, melds, turn, claim window, counts, and scores.
rules.recovery: A Leader change preserves scores, dealer, and hand counter, discards hidden state, and starts a fresh hand.
